svg.aria-label: TwistLock cam section, open and locked
svg.text: TwistLock Pin - section through the fingers (at the catch lip)
Same 2 moulded parts, only the cam angle changes. Dimensions in mm, drawn to scale.
Flats face the fingers: 0.35 mm free travel each side.
Pull the pin -> 45 deg lip ramp pushes the fingers in ->
lip (now 4.80) passes the 4.85 bore. Easy to remove.
Arcs face the fingers: no inward travel.
Lip (5.4) stays behind the 4.85 bore = locked.
Cam preload 0.01 mm/side removes the wobble.
